messages:
Emma H: Heads up — scheduling a microcohort canary for session-token-service tomorrow 22:00 UTC. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 30m windows. Rollback criteria: 5xx spike, error-rate delta, or p95 regressions. Need deploy + smoke owners. :calendar: 
Raj P: I can own the deploy and smoke runs. Adding to my calendar. Will be primary contact during ramp.
Sasha L: Quick question — are we doing geo slices or purely random sampling for the 5% step?
Emma H: Geo for the 5% (FR/DE/UK) then host-bucket for 25%. Start at random 1% as a sanity gate. Use cohort tag `micro-geo`.
Carlos M: CI is green for the release branch. There's one tiny fix in PR #1422 I pushed; can we merge before cut?
Emma H: @Carlos M yes please rebase and push `canary-ready` tag. We’ll wait ~10m for the merge.
DeployBot: Deployer queue updated — Raj P assigned to session-token-service canary (job id: DPL-8841).
Alex O: I’ll be on-call during the ramp (first 60m). If anything looks flaky, @Raj P ping me and I’ll coordinate traffic rollback.
Raj P: Smoke checklist I’ll run: 1) auth flows 2) token mint latency check 3) Datadog dashboards 4) end-to-end login script. Smoke command I’ll use: `./scripts/smoke_canary.sh --env=canary`
Sasha L: For observability, use the new canary dashboard (dash id: frontend/session-token-canary). Watch: error-rate, p95, token-failure-rate, and KV-drop. I’ll monitor logs for `token_expiry` warnings.
Emma H: SLA guardrails: if p95 > 600ms OR error-rate delta > 0.4% OR 5xx > 0.5% for a 5m sliding window, we rollback. Confirm everyone ok with thresholds?
Carlos M: ack on thresholds. If we rollback, do we switch to previous variant or route to fallback region?
Emma H: Primary rollback is switching model variant to v1.9 + reroute geo buckets to us-east fallback if region-specific issues appear. Documented in runbook section 4.2.
Raj P: Merged PR and pushed tag `canary-ready`. Starting canary now — initiating 1% cohort. Smoke run in progress.
Raj P: Smoke results: auth smoke OK, issuance p95 180ms, no 5xx seen in 1%. Logs: `OK auth; p95=180ms; errors=0` :white_check_mark:
Sasha L: Observability — dashboards look clean. No unusual spikes.
Alex O: No alerts so far from SLOs. I'll stay on until 00:00 UTC.
Raj P: Ramping to 5% (geo cohorts). Waiting 20m steady-state before the 25% bump.
Sasha L: Confirm cohort mapping: 1% random users -> 5% FR/DE/UK -> 25% host-bucket. If capacity low, fallback to random split.
Emma H: Confirmed. Also note: if Datadog alert `session-token::error_rate_high` fires, we stop ramp and notify oncall.
Raj P: 5% steady-state after 20m: p95 200ms, error delta +0.08%, 5xx stable. Proceeding to 25%.
DeployBot: Deployment event: canary bumped to 25% (job id: DPL-8841) — state=SUCCESS
Raj P: Canary at 25% complete. All smoke checks green, no SLO violations. Marking this canary as PASSED and scheduling full rollout window per prod calendar.
Alex O: Nice work team — :thumbsup: Closing my oncall window at 00:00, will remain reachable for post-rollout questions.
Emma H: Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) Raj to create rollout ticket with timestamps 2) Sasha to snapshot dashboards 3) Carlos to follow-up on post-deploy metrics job.
Carlos M: Will do a quick perf run and post results in the ticket.
Raj P: Done — ticket PROD-5923 created and assigned.
Emma H: Great, closing thread.
